nodes.label: Cache Storage API Calls
nodes.rationale: localStorage, sessionStorage and document.cookie are synchronous and expensive, so reads are memoized in a module-level Map (not a hook, so it works outside components). The cost of caching is staleness, accepted only with explicit invalidation: writes keep the cache in sync, the storage event deletes changed keys, and visibilitychange clears the whole cache when another tab or the server may have changed it. Impact LOW-MEDIUM.
